vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines geometric primitives for 3D spatial representation, specifically BoundingBox and BoundingSphere. BoundingBox encapsulates a volume using min/max coordinates along X, Y, and Z axes, while BoundingSphere uses a center point and radius. Both classes inherit from JsonSerializable, facilitating serialization for data persistence and network communication within the geometry subsystem.
